2023-07-30
Claim received for a left-turn collision at an intersection, with the insured's vehicle struck while the claimant was
turning across oncoming traffic. Claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will route through the
attorney's office.
2023-07-31
Reviewed the police report and the photos taken at the scene. The other driver's statement mathces the claimant's
account, and two independent witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle and the collision occurred as
described.
2023-08-14
Inspected the vehicle with the appraiser. The damage pattern lines up with the imapct described, and the repair
estimate reflects only what this collision would produce.
2023-08-26
Confirmed the driver is listed on the policy and that coverage was in force at the time of loss. Nothing in the file points
to prior damage to this vehicle, and the prior-loss history is clean.
2023-10-19
Received the initial medical report documenting whiplash. The injury is consistent with the mechanism of a side
impact of this kind, and the claimant has no rceord of prior complaints involving the same area of the body.
2023-10-26
Treatment began with a physical therapy plan and followed the usual course for soft-tissue neck injuries. Notes show
steady improvement, and visit frequency has tapered as the claimant's symptoms eased.
2023-11-10
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who provided the treatment records. The account given to the attorney matches
what the claimant told me in our earlier calls, with no changes to the sequence or the description of the collision.
2023-12-16
Reviewed the file with the supervisor. All sources agree on how the accident occurred and on the claimant's presence
in the vehicle, and the medical course and vehicle damage fit the reported loss. Claim remains open pending final
treatment summary.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
